question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
-- Calculate percentage change in sales for each year
-- Pre: weeks 21-24 (leading up to June 15)
-- Post: weeks 25-28 (following June 15)
SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 21 AND 24 THEN sales END) as pre_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 25 AND 28 THEN sales END) as post_sales,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 25 AND 28 THEN sales END) - SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 21 AND 24 THEN sales END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 21 AND 24 THEN sales END) as pct_change
FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
GROUP BY calendar_year
ORDER BY calendar_year

-- Calculate percentage change in sales for each year
-- Pre: weeks 21-24 (leading up to June 15)
-- Post: weeks 25-28 (following June 15)
SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 21 AND 24 THEN sales END) as pre_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 25 AND 28 THEN sales END) as post_sales,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 25 AND 28 THEN sales END) - SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 21 AND 24 THEN sales END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 21 AND 24 THEN sales END) as pct_change
FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
GROUP BY calendar_year
ORDER BY calendar_year
